examples.en: McCreary lives in a converted schoolhouse outside Charlottesville.
examples.zh: 麦克里里住在夏洛茨维尔市外一幢校舍改建的小楼里。

examples.en: Alfred went musing into the deserted schoolhouse.
examples.zh: 阿尔弗雷德若有所思地走进空寂无人的的校舍。

examples.en: I was asked to lead a small team of local people in building a new schoolhouse.
examples.zh: 我被要求带领一个当地的小团队建造一个新的校舍。
